title: How I Searched for a Promising Catch
overview: Lady Maria goes to study abroad in the Kingdom of Rubini to find her future husband.

title: How I Caught the One That Got Away
overview: Renato apologizes profusely to Maria, who learns the truth about his engagement to Aida.

title: How I Trained to Become a Lady
overview: After Prince Renato’s declaration, Maria faces a crucial moment: meeting her in-laws.

title: How the One That Got Away Was Troubled
overview: Maria is approached by Renato's cousin Ireneo, a notorious playboy.

title: How the One That Got Away Visited Home
overview: Maria runs into trouble on the road home to the Kingdom of Muro.

title: How the One That Got Away Fought with Her Father
overview: During her trip home, Maria worries how her family will react to her engagement to Prince Renato.

title: The Fists of the One That Got Away
overview: On her way back to Rubini, Maria checks in on Navarro village.

title: The Secret Date of the One That Got Away
overview: After concluding their business in Navarro village, Maria and Renato go on a secret date.

title: The One Who Got Away Plays Cupid
overview: With their own engagement soon to be announced, Maria and Renato wonder how to get Aida and Placido together.

title: The One Who Got Away Prepares For a Ball
overview: Maria enlists the help of friends and acquaintances to prepare for a ball at the royal castle.

title: The One That Got Away Gets Dragged Into Romantic Trouble
overview: Maria feels guilty about Ireneo not being invited to the ball and brings him a peach tart.

title: How I Punched My Way into Marrying a Prince
overview: The dust settles, and the ball finally begins.
